top_signals.title: Molavi: Saudis & Houthis Can Hit Hard; Not End War
top_signals.summary: Oil prices were low as concerns eased in the Middle East over supply disruptions. This is after the Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia did not cause any interruptions that markets had feared. The IEA also raised its forecast for the war's impact on supply. Meanwhile the question looms of US military support to Saudi Arabia in their fight against the Iran-backed rebels in Yemen. Afshin Molavi, senior fellow at Johns Hopkins University's School of Advanced International Studies spoke to Bloomberg’s Abeer Abu Omar on Horizons Middle East & Africa on the likelihood of US involvement. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Young: Houthis Threat Not New But Tactics Elevated
top_signals.summary: Oil prices were low as concerns eased in the Middle East over supply disruptions. The IEA also raised its forecast for the war's impact on supply. Karen Young, Senior Research Scholar at Columbia University's Center on Global Energy Policy spoke to Bloomberg’s Abeer Abu Omar on Horizons Middle East & Africa over the lack of disruptions caused by the Houthi attacks on Saudi Aramco’s facilities. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: NYU's Marcus on Why AI May Be a 'Flawed Tool'
top_signals.summary: Gary Marcus, Emeritus Professor of Psychology at NYU, discusses whether AI is having a measurable impact on productivity, and shares his thoughts on why LLMs could be considered a "flawed tool." He speaks at Bloomberg's New Economy Forum in New Delhi. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
